title: lint.sh gate 5 echoes gate 4's $HITS instead of $LB_HITS on failure
evidence: +if [ -n "$LB_HITS" ]; then echo "$HITS"; echo "FAIL: load-balancing mechanic in core/ (routing ruling: bundles pool, no LB)"; FAIL=1; fi
detail: Gate 5 accumulates matches into LB_HITS and tests it, but echoes $HITS — gate 4's variable. On failure it prints stale/empty gate-4 output, hiding which file/line tripped the LB gate.
recommended_fix: Change `echo "$HITS"` to `echo "$LB_HITS"` so the failure reports the actual load-balancing matches.

title: f32(count-1) underflows if a bundle row ever has count 0
evidence:
+		count := bundles.bundle_count[bi]
+		col := tier_pipe_color(v, tier)
+		width := (tier_pipe_width(v, tier) + f32(count-1)*BUNDLE_EXTRA_WIDTH) * v.scale
detail: count is u32; count-1 wraps to 0xFFFFFFFF if count is 0, and f32(...) then renders the edge at a gigantic width. The rebuild invariant guarantees count>=1, so this is latent only — not currently reachable.
recommended_fix: Use f32(max(count,1)-1) or assert count>0 so a future invariant break surfaces as a clean failure rather than a garbled frame.
